lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਆਨੇਰੁ ਬਿਨਾਸਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee ghat chaananaa aaner binaasan ||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, one's heart is illumined, and the darkness is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukame hee sabh saajeean raviaa sabh van trin ||
lines.translation: By the Hukam of His Command, He creates everything; He pervades and permeates all the woods and meadows.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap hai guramukh sadaa har bhan ||
lines.translation: He Himself is everything; the Gurmukh constantly chants the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sabade hee sojhee paee sachai aap bujhaaee ||5||
lines.translation: Through the Shabad, understanding comes; the True Lord Himself inspires us to understand. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: abhiaagat ehi na aakheean jin ke chit mahi bharam ||
lines.translation: He is not called a renunciate, whose consciousness is filled with doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਦਿਤੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis dai ditai naanakaa teho jehaa dharam ||
lines.translation: Donations to him bring proportionate rewards.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭੂਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: abhai nira(n)jan param pad taa kaa bhookhaa hoi ||
lines.translation: He hungers for the supreme status of the Fearless, Immaculate Lord;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tis kaa bhojan naanakaa viralaa paae koi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, how rare are those who offer him this food. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: abhiaagat ehi na aakheean j par ghar bhojan karen ||
lines.translation: They are not called renunciates, who take food in the homes of others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਰੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਬਹਲੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: udarai kaaran aapane bahale bhekh karen ||
lines.translation: For the sake of their bellies, they wear various religious robes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਆਤਮ ਗਉਣੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: abhiaagat seee naanakaa j aatam gaun karen ||
lines.translation: They alone are renunciates, O Nanak, who enter into their own souls.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਲਿ ਲਹਨਿ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਰਹਣੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhaal lahan sahu aapanaa nij ghar rahan karen ||2||
lines.translation: They seek and find their Husband Lord; they dwell within the home of their own inner self. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਰੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)bar dharat vichhoRian vich sachaa asaraau ||
lines.translation: They sky and the earth are separate, but the True Lord supports them from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਸਭੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar dar sabho sach hai jis vich sachaa naau ||
lines.translation: True are all those homes and gates, within which the True Name is enshrined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sachaa hukam varatadaa guramukh sach samaau ||
lines.translation: The Hukam of the True Lord's Command is effective everywhere. The Gurmukh merges in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਬਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa aap takhat sachaa bahi sachaa kare niaau ||
lines.translation: He Himself is True, and True is His throne. Seated upon it, He administers true justice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sacho sach varatadaa guramukh alakh lakhaaee ||6||
lines.translation: The Truest of the True is all-pervading everywhere; the Gurmukh sees the unseen. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਾਇਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਨੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rainaair maahi ana(n)t hai kooRee aavai jaai ||
lines.translation: In the world-ocean, the Infinite Lord abides. The false come and go in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaanai chalai aapanai bahutee lahai sajaai ||
lines.translation: One who walks according to his own will, suffers terrible punishment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਾਇਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rainaair mahi sabh kichh hai karamee palai paai ||
lines.translation: All things are in the world-ocean, but they are obtained only by the karma of good actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nau nidh paaeeai je chalai tisai rajaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he alone obtains the nine treasures, who walks in the Will of the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje satigur na sevio vich haumai janam binaas ||
lines.translation: One who doesn't intuitively serve the True Guru, loses his life in egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਖਿਓ ਕਮਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa har ras na chakhio kamal na hoio paragaas ||
lines.translation: His tongue does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and his heart-lotus does not blossom forth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikh khaadhee manamukh muaa maaiaa mohi vinaas ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh eats poison and dies; he is ruined by love and attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikas har ke naam vin dhrig jeevan dhrig vaas ||
lines.translation: Without the Name of the One Lord, his life is cursed, and his home is cursed as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa aape nadar kare prabh sachaa taa hovai daasan daas ||
lines.translation: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, then one becomes the slave of His slaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਪਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa anadin sevaa kare satiguroo kee kabahi na chhodai paas ||
lines.translation: And then, night and day, he serves the True Guru, and never leaves His side.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਉ ਵਿਚੇ ਗਿਰਹ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jal mahi kamal alipato varatai tiu viche girah udaas ||
lines.translation: As the lotus flower floats unaffected in the water, so does he remain detached in his own household.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kare karaaiaa sabh ko jiu bhaavai tiv har gunataas ||2||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, the Lord acts, and inspires everyone to act, according to the Pleasure of His Will. He is the treasure of virtue. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਤੀਹ ਜੁਗ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਸਾ ਆਪੇ ਗਣਤ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhateeh jug gubaar saa aape ganat keenee ||
lines.translation: For thirty-six ages, there was utter darkness. Then, the Lord revealed Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape srisat sabh saajeean aap mat deenee ||
lines.translation: He Himself created the entire universe. He Himself blessed it with understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਾਜਿਅਨੁ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: simrit saasat saajian paap pu(n)n ganat ganeenee ||
lines.translation: He created the Simritees and the Shaastras; He calculates the accounts of virtue and vice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis bujhaae so bujhasee sachai sabad pateenee ||
lines.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand and to be pleased with the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sabh aape aap varatadaa aape bakhas milaaee ||7||
lines.translation: He Himself is all-pervading; He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਰਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੰਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tan sabho rat hai rat bin ta(n)n na hoi ||
lines.translation: This body is all blood; without blood, the body cannot exist.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਹਿ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਣੈ ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sahi rate aapanai tin tan lobh rat na hoi ||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to their Lord - their bodies are not filled with the blood of greed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai paiai tan kheen hoi lobh rat vichahu jaai ||
lines.translation: In the Fear of God, the body becomes thin, and the blood of greed passes out of the body.
